The meaning
A name that means "severus alexander's powerful mother" .
Mamaea (Julia Avita Mamaea, c. 180-235) was the Syrian-Roman empress — niece of Septimius Severus, mother of Emperor Severus Alexander, whom she ruled through for thirteen years. Killed beside her son when their soldiers mutinied.
Featured in Edward Gibbon's Decline and Fall .
